title: Fixed Deposits and Interest Calculation
content: Fixed Deposits (FDs) are financial instruments provided by banks and NBFCs that offer a guaranteed interest rate until a given maturity date. FDs feature fixed tenures ranging from 7 days to 10 years. Interest earned on bank FDs is fully taxable as 'Income from Other Sources' at the investor's applicable income tax slab rate. Banks deduct Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) at 10% under Section 194A if total FD interest income across bank branches exceeds ₹40,000 in a financial year (₹50,000 for Senior Citizens).
